description: 기상청_CCTV 기반 도로날씨정보 조회서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청. CCTV 지점별 도로날씨정보 조회와 표준노드링크별 도로날씨정보 조회를 제공하는 서비스 기상청의 CCTV 기반 도로날씨정보 조회서비스는 전국 주요 도로에 설치된 도로 기상관측 장비(RWIS. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기상청. Its tags are CCTV 지점별 도로날씨, 표준노드링크별 도로날씨, 도로기상정보, 기온, 강수. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
